description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing user profile data, including fetching the current user's profile, updating user details, and managing profile status. It interacts with external APIs and dispatches actions to update the application state.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current user's profile data and dispatches actions based on success or failure.

methods.name: fetchProfileStatus
methods.description: Creates an action to update the profile fetch status in the Redux store.

methods.name: changeUserDetails
methods.description: Asynchronously updates user details such as email, password, and phone, and dispatches relevant actions based on the outcome.
